followUpChecks: Check soil moisture with a finger or meter before watering; water when the top few centimeters feel dry, then record the date and amount.
Inspect leaves and stems for pests, discoloration, or damage, and photograph the plant weekly.
Monitor drooping for 24-48 hours after watering to see whether it improves.
Confirm the pot has drainage and that excess water can escape; avoid letting the plant sit in standing water.
Record light exposure, temperature, and humidity if possible, and note any recent changes.
If drooping persists despite moist soil, review pot size, drainage, and light, and consider a professional assessment.
